My current research is on ethical AI and AI governance. I build open, reproducible text-analysis methods, based on transformer models and large language models, to compare what organisations claim with what they do. Earlier strands, listed below, cover transformer-based mapping of research fields, generative AI in management education, and financial market microstructure and connectedness.

Full records: [Google Scholar](https://scholar.google.co.in/citations?user=m9SYPDMAAAAJ) · [ORCID](https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5740-0804) · [Scopus](https://www.scopus.com/authid/detail.uri?authorId=57214111533) · [BibTeX](publications.bib).

## Research programme

### Mapping research fields with language models

![](img/Project%201.png){.column-margin fig-alt="Topic clusters produced by transformer-based topic modelling"}

An ongoing programme extending bibliometric analysis with transformer-based language models. Instead of stopping at citation counts and co-word maps, we embed the full text of abstracts, cluster them with BERTopic, and use the resulting structure to recommend under-explored topics. Applied so far to green finance, luxury fashion marketing, neuromarketing and Global South higher education.
